'''Mingming''' a male NPC who is part of the [[Ministry of Development|Defense Division]] that [[Taoqi]] works in. He can be found at the loading dock below [[Jinzhou City Hall]] during the day.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mingming:''' You know- if the Midnight Rangers protect the city from the outside, then we at the Defense Division support the city by maintaining its stability from the inside.
:'''Mingming:''' Everything you see, from the shield over our heads to the high-precision instruments deployed on every street, are the work of the people who came before us.
:'''Mingming:''' I wonder when I will be able to catch up with them, especially Senior Taoqi!
:'''Mingming:''' Although She has a nonchalant air around her like she's trying to slack off, she always notices the things that everyone else overlooks.
:'''Mingming:''' I am wondering if Taoqi's "slow response" is deliberate. 
:'''Mingming:''' This way, there is more time to see what is happening around you. Should I also try to learn it?
{{Dialogue End}}
